result:
I’d make the circumstances of your birth matter far less to the life you get to live.

Not make everyone the same, or promise that nothing would hurt. Just stop letting a birthplace, a family’s poverty, or someone else’s prejudice close so many doors before a person can even reach them.

There would still be luck, conflict, ambition, heartbreak. But more people would have a real chance to find out who they could become, rather than spend their whole lives surviving what they never chose.
